items.description: Done when: the scraper walks the server-side date-filtered listing inside the Horizon only (hard page cap, fail loud), every emitted occurrence passes the shared Horizon predicate, listing/HTTP fetches run behind a named test seam with fixtures (frozen clock, patched sleeps), each run records pages/cards/unique-details/details/emitted and warns below half the trailing median, and the registration-contract test plus suite-index entry are green alongside python tests, lint, feed validation, and database tests.
items.notes: Done. Added scrapers/wfiu_community_calendar.py (Pattern A: name=WFIU Community Calendar, domain=ipm.org, timezone=America/Indiana/Indianapolis, source_url=listing): walks ?f1=<today00:00Ms>-<horizonMs>&p=1..N, reads the rendered '1 of N', PAGE_CAP=80 raises, one detail fetch per unique URL (DETAIL_CAP=500 raises) for brightspot.contentId, emits one event per occurrence card, and re-checks every dtstart with the shared Horizon predicate. Module-level _fetch_html/_now seams + fixtures in tests/fixtures/bloomington/; sleeps patched/frozen clock. Run history report/bloomington/wfiu_community_calendar.runs.json records pages/cards_fetched/unique_detail_urls/details_fetched/emitted and warns below 50% of the trailing-7-run card median. Added WFIU Community Calendar to source_priority.json aggregators and the pending_feeds.txt entry (needed so the new-scraper feed-validation rule passes; add_scraper.py's live test cannot run unattended, so item 4 owns the test-only page cap + docs). Pre-approved decisions (unattended): detail fetch included in the tracer so details_fetched is real and the seam covers both fetch kinds; card-only field mapping (item 3 enriches from detail); date binding leaves the Horizon predicate as the authoritative guard. 25 new tests; TEST_SUITE.md updated. Gates: pytest 209 pass, make lint-python clean, supabase test db pass, feed validation run against origin/main after commit.
items.title: WFIU 1: listing tracer bullet

items.description: Done when: dateless cards bind to the in-Horizon year (weekday-agreement rollover with warned fallback), time blocks yield timed city-zone events with literal late endings and midnight rollover, unparseable times degrade to all-day with a warning while unparseable dates raise after a small threshold, start-only events carry a one-hour duration, multi-day runs emit one timed event per day with no synthesized span, and identity/dedupe keys on content id plus date plus time block.
items.notes: Done. Time and identity hardening in scrapers/wfiu_community_calendar.py. _bind_year now takes the Horizon date and binds a year-less month/day inside [today, horizon], preferring the year whose weekday agrees and warning (agreed=False) when it falls back to the earliest in-window candidate; unbindable dates log ERROR and raise once a run exceeds DATE_ERROR_THRESHOLD=3. _time_range gained a start-only branch (_START_ONLY) yielding a one-hour event, and _resolve_end turns a start==end block into one hour while leaving a genuine past-midnight end literal; _parse_card rolls the date forward rather than coercing to all-day. Multi-day run cards still emit exactly one same-day timed VEVENT (listing expansion trusted). Identity/dedupe now key on content id + occurrence date + normalized time block (_time_key), and fetch_events dedupes emitted UIDs so duplicate cards collapse while same-day matinee/evening showings stay distinct. 11 new tests in TestTimeAndIdentity plus the updated UID-shape test. Pre-approved decisions (unattended): a zero-duration block reads as start-only (1h) rather than a 24h rollover; unbindable (past or beyond-Horizon) dates count toward the loud threshold; dedupe keys on the UID, which encodes the triple. Gates: pytest 220 pass; make lint-python clean (ruff + 4 type checkers); validate_pr_feeds --base-ref origin/main pass; supabase test db pass.
items.title: WFIU 2: time and identity hardening

items.description: Done when: each unique detail URL is fetched once (cap raises, never truncates), canonical fields come from the detail with card fallback, locations carry venue plus postal geography with postal-less counts visible, descriptions are plain text with presenting-organization prepended and ticket line appended, failed details emit card fallbacks counting toward a small raising threshold with retry logic unchanged, and dedup keeps direct sources over this aggregator while merging fellow-aggregator echoes.
items.notes: Done. Detail enrichment + geography in scrapers/wfiu_community_calendar.py: _parse_detail reads canonical content_id/title/venue/street/city/state/zip/description/presenting-org/ticket/image; _build_location mirrors Visit Bloomington (venue, street, city, state ZIP) so the shared city filter can act; _assemble_description strips detail HTML to plain text with 'Presented by <org>' prepended and 'Tickets: <url>' appended (event url stays the WFIU detail page); _plain_text now html.unescapes so entities do not leak. _fetch_details catches per-URL failures (retry unchanged), warns, and counts; > DETAIL_ERROR_THRESHOLD (3) raises before emitting. Each unique detail URL is fetched and parsed once; cards fall back to card title/venue/description and card-URL identity when the detail lacks fields/content id. Run record gains postal_less (emitted events with no detail ZIP) and logs details/postal-less. Duplicate-URL fetch-once and content-id fallback covered. Pre-approved decisions (unattended): DETAIL_ERROR_THRESHOLD=3 mirrors the date threshold; failed details below threshold still emit card fallbacks (Q4); postal-less counted per emitted event. 49 WFIU tests (+ fixtures wfiu_detail_minimal.html, wfiu_detail_no_meta.html); TEST_SUITE.md updated. Gates: pytest 233 pass, ruff/typecheck clean, test-node 211 pass, pnpm bench PASS, validate_pr_feeds pass, supabase test db PASS.
items.title: WFIU 3: detail enrichment and geography

items.description: Done when: the source is registered through the standard flow (test-only page cap for the registration test, unbounded registered command), the display name is identical in scraper/pending-entry/database-row/attribution, aggregator ranking falls out of the existing single-tier sort with no new architecture record, stale dead-end guidance and glossary/platform notes are corrected, and python tests, lint and typecheck, feed validation, database tests, and the performance gate are all green.
items.notes: Done. Registration smoke-test cap, doc corrections, and calibration recorded. scrapers/wfiu_community_calendar.py reads env-only SCRAPER_TEST_PAGE_CAP via _test_page_cap() (read at call time; empty/invalid ignored): _walk_listing stops cleanly at the cap and skips the PAGE_CAP total-raise, and fetch_events skips run-history while armed so a smoke run cannot pollute the trailing median. scripts/add_scraper.py test_scraper now sets SCRAPER_TEST_PAGE_CAP=1 as an environment-only smoke bound (the registered command stays unbounded) and documents it. Display name 'WFIU Community Calendar' verified identical in the scraper class name, the pending_feeds comment (the DB row name), and X-SOURCE/X-SOURCE-URL; aggregator entry already in source_priority.json with no dedup change beyond it and no new ADR. Docs: removed the stale 'Indiana Public Media — Brightspot CMS, no ICS/RSS for events' dead end, added WFIU to the Aggregators (11) built table, and added a 2026-09-19 run-log entry with the 93-day calibration (67 pages / 667 cards / 348 detail URLs); fixed the --name attribution inaccuracy in CONTEXT.md and AGENTS.md; added the Brightspot server-rendered HTML path to docs/platforms.md. Tests: TestRegistrationSmokeTest (4) + tests/test_add_scraper.py (1); TEST_SUITE.md updated. Pre-approved decisions (unattended): env-only test cap armed by add_scraper (no CLI arg, so the registered command is unchanged); smoke runs skip run history to protect the degradation median; invalid cap values are ignored. Gates: pytest 238 pass, node 211 pass, make lint-python clean (ruff + 4 type checkers), validate_pr_feeds --base-ref origin/main pass, supabase test db pass, pnpm bench PASS.
